```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, knitr, janitor, readxl, reactable, htmltools, base64enc, plotly, jsonlite)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONFIG — set these for each run. Filenames are date-stamped exports that
# change every time, so they're entered explicitly rather than auto-detected.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
version_number <- "1.1"

base_path  <- "/Users/irf/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-AlpenGlasfaserGmbH/rimo_infopoints/"
input_path <- paste0(base_path, "input_files/")

# ↓↓↓ update these three for every new export ↓↓↓
infopoints_file          <- "Customized_InfoLocations_privates_LR_2026_08_03.csv"
infopoints_enriched_file <- "infopoints_enriched_2026_05_08.csv"
excel_file               <- "LR_Report_Gemeinden_2027_07_27.xlsx"
fttx_file                <- "Queries_FttxLocations_2026_08_04.csv"
baulos_lookup_fttx_file  <- "baulos_lookup_fttx_2026_08_04.csv"
# ↑↑↑ update these for every new export ↑↑↑

fttx_path                <- "/Users/irf/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-AlpenGlasfaserGmbH/agf_data_export/"

infopoints_path          <- paste0(input_path, infopoints_file)
infopoints_enriched_path <- paste0(input_path, infopoints_enriched_file)
excel_path               <- paste0(input_path, excel_file)

# Export date parsed from infopoints_file's name (format: ..._YYYY_MM_DD,
# optionally followed by .csv or a same-day suffix like _evening). Matched
# anywhere in the string rather than anchored to the end, since the exact
# trailing text varies (.csv extension, _evening, etc.).
infopoints_export_date <- infopoints_file |>
  str_extract("\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}") |>
  str_replace_all("_", "-")
if (is.na(infopoints_export_date)) infopoints_export_date <- "unbekannt"

# Weekly org-wide status trend summary for Kapitel 6, sheet "Statusentwicklung"
# (already excludes on-hold projects — see the sheet's own title cell).
# Columns: Datum (text, e.g. "KW 06"), abgelehnt, angesucht, erhalten, offen,
# storniert, no response. One row per week, starting row 3 (header row 2).
lr_status_history_path <- paste0(base_path, "input_files/lr_report_pia/LR-Statusentwicklung_piha_neu.xlsx")

# fail fast with a clear message rather than a cryptic read_csv2 error
all_input_files <- c(infopoints_path, infopoints_enriched_path, excel_path, lr_status_history_path)
missing_files   <- all_input_files[!file.exists(all_input_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "File(s) not found — check filenames in the CONFIG block:\n  ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n  ")
  )
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# load infopoints
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
infopoints_all <- read_csv2(
  infopoints_path,
  name_repair = "minimal"
) |>
  select(-last_col())

yes_no_cols <- c("built", "Payment required", "canceled", "payed")
infopoints_all <- infopoints_all |>
  mutate(across(all_of(yes_no_cols), ~ str_to_title(str_trim(.x))))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# load full project list for Quellen page
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
project_list_full <- read_excel(
  excel_path,
  sheet = "Gemeinde PB Zuordnung"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# active projects (not on hold)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
project_list <- project_list_full |>
  rename(
    `Planned by` = Gemeinden,
    LR_Akquise   = `LR-Akquise`,
    Bau_Planung  = `Bau/Planung`
  ) |>
  filter(Bau_Planung != "on hold") |>
  select(`Planned by`, PB, PCM, LR_Akquise, Bau_Planung,
         ende_bau_passiv_plan, project_id_ods) |>
  distinct()

meilenstein_projects <- unique(project_list$`Planned by`)

# all active-project infopoints (including canceled) — used for KPI counts
infopoints_active <- infopoints_all |>
  filter(`Planned by` %in% meilenstein_projects) |>
  left_join(project_list, by = "Planned by")

# main analysis dataset: active projects, non-canceled only
infopoints <- infopoints_active |>
  filter(is.na(Status) | str_to_lower(str_trim(Status)) != "canceled")

# Costs_numeric needed throughout
infopoints <- infopoints |>
  mutate(
    Costs_numeric = Costs |>
      str_extract("\\d+[,.]?\\d*") |>
      str_replace(",", ".") |>
      as.numeric()
  )

# ── join spatial enrichment (from preprocessing.R) ────────────────────────
# NOTE (2026-07): built_trasses, trasse_count, trasse_length_m, and
# length_without_permission_m are currently unused — Section 6.6, the only
# consumer of this data, is commented out pending verification of how
# preprocessing.R aggregates trasse rows per infopoint (possible 1:many
# relationship would double-count meters — see note at old Section 6.6).
# Re-enable the columns below alongside that section once resolved.
infopoints_enriched_cols <- read_csv2(
  infopoints_enriched_path,
  name_repair = "minimal"
) |>
  select(`External ID`
         # , built_trasses, trasse_count,
         # trasse_length_m, length_without_permission_m
         )

infopoints <- infopoints |>
  left_join(infopoints_enriched_cols, by = "External ID")

# ── Baulos lookup (pre-computed by preprocessing_baulos.R) ───────────────────
# Run preprocessing_baulos.R once whenever the GeoJSON or infopoints CSV
# changes. That script does the spatial intersection and writes baulos_lookup.csv.
baulos_lookup_path <- paste0(input_path, "baulos_lookup_2026_08_05.csv")

if (file.exists(baulos_lookup_path)) {
  baulos_lookup <- read_csv(baulos_lookup_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  warning("baulos_lookup.csv not found — run preprocessing_baulos.R first. ",
          "Baulos filter will be empty.")
  baulos_lookup <- tibble(`External ID` = character(),
                          `Planned by`  = character(),
                          baulos_name   = character())
}

# Per-project list of distinct Baulos names (for the JS dropdown)
pp_baulos_by_project <- baulos_lookup |>
  distinct(`Planned by`, baulos_name) |>
  arrange(`Planned by`, baulos_name)

# ── FttX Locations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fttx_full_path       <- paste0(fttx_path, fttx_file)
baulos_fttx_path     <- paste0(input_path, baulos_lookup_fttx_file)

SCOPING_LEVELS <- c("In Scope", "Outside Build Scope", "Non Connectable", "NA / leer")

if (file.exists(fttx_full_path)) {
  fttx_raw <- read_csv2(fttx_full_path, name_repair = "unique",
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Select only the columns we need before renaming — avoids issues with
  # duplicate or empty column names in the raw export
  fttx_raw <- fttx_raw |>
    select(`External ID`, `POP cluster`, Scoping, `Planned TU`,
           Latitude, Longitude)

  # Normalise: replace NA/empty Scoping with label, coerce Planned TU to numeric
  fttx <- fttx_raw |>
    rename(`Planned by` = `POP cluster`) |>
    filter(!is.na(`Planned by`) & `Planned by` != "") |>
    filter(`Planned by` %in% meilenstein_projects) |>
    mutate(
      Scoping     = if_else(is.na(Scoping) | str_trim(Scoping) == "",
                            "NA / leer", str_trim(Scoping)),
      `Planned TU` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
                       str_replace(as.character(`Planned TU`), ",", ".")
                     ))
    )

  # Baulos lookup for FttX (produced by preprocessing_baulos.R)
  if (file.exists(baulos_fttx_path)) {
    baulos_lookup_fttx <- read_csv(baulos_fttx_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      rename(`Planned by` = `POP cluster`)
  } else {
    warning("baulos_lookup_fttx not found — run preprocessing_baulos.R first.")
    baulos_lookup_fttx <- tibble(`External ID` = character(),
                                 `Planned by`  = character(),
                                 baulos_name   = character())
  }

  fttx <- fttx |>
    left_join(baulos_lookup_fttx |> select(`External ID`, baulos_name),
              by = "External ID")

} else {
  warning("FttX file not found — FttX card will be empty.")
  fttx <- tibble(`External ID` = character(), `Planned by` = character(),
                 Scoping = character(), `Planned TU` = numeric(),
                 baulos_name = character())
}

n_total_all            <- nrow(infopoints_all)
n_total_active         <- nrow(infopoints_active)
n_canceled              <- nrow(infopoints_active) - nrow(infopoints)
n_total                <- nrow(infopoints)   # non-canceled active
# NOTE (2026-07): n_projects_all previously counted distinct "Planned by"
# strings found in the raw infopoints CSV — this could diverge from the
# actual project list (typos, stale names, projects with 0 infopoints so
# far) and did not match the Excel's own count of active projects. Fixed to
# count directly from the Excel project list, the source of truth.
n_projects_all          <- project_list_full |>
  filter(`Bau/Planung` != "on hold") |>
  distinct(Gemeinden) |>
  nrow()
n_projects_meilenstein  <- n_distinct(infopoints$`Planned by`, na.rm = TRUE)
today                   <- Sys.Date()

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
pct <- function(x, total = n_total) {
  paste0(x, " (", round(100 * x / total, 1), "%)")
}

na_label <- function(df, col = "Status") {
  df |> mutate(!!col := if_else(is.na(.data[[col]]) | .data[[col]] == "", "NA / leer", .data[[col]]))
}

add_col_totals <- function(df) {
  label_col    <- names(df)[1]
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  col_sums <- df |>
    summarise(across(all_of(numeric_cols), sum)) |>
    mutate(!!label_col := "Total")
  bind_rows(df, col_sums)
}

add_pct_cols <- function(df, pct_base) {
  label_col    <- names(df)[1]
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  text_cols    <- setdiff(names(df)[-1], numeric_cols)
  result <- df |> select(all_of(label_col))
  for (col in text_cols)    result[[col]] <- df[[col]]
  for (col in numeric_cols) {
    base            <- if (is.character(pct_base)) df[[pct_base]] else pct_base
    result[[col]]               <- df[[col]]
    result[[paste0(col, " %")]] <- round(100 * df[[col]] / base, 1)
  }
  result
}

rt <- function(df, title = NULL,
               highlight_rows  = NULL,
               highlight_bg    = "#fff3cd",
               highlight_color = "#856404",
               na_leer_row     = TRUE) {
  label_col <- names(df)[1]
  data_rows <- df |> filter(.data[[label_col]] != "Total")
  total_row <- df |> filter(.data[[label_col]] == "Total")
  has_total <- nrow(total_row) > 0

  pct_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "%$")]
  num_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]

  make_footer <- function(col) {
    if (!has_total) return(NULL)
    val <- total_row[[col]]
    if (col %in% pct_cols) {
      function(values, name) tags$b(paste0(val, "%"), style = "color:#fff; font-size:0.85em;")
    } else {
      function(values, name) tags$b(as.character(val), style = "color:#fff;")
    }
  }

  col_defs <- lapply(names(df), function(col) {
    if (col %in% pct_cols) {
      colDef(name = col, align = "right", minWidth = 70,
             style = list(color = "#888", fontSize = "0.85em"),
             cell  = function(val) if (!is.na(val)) paste0(val, "%") else "",
             footer = make_footer(col))
    } else if (col %in% num_cols) {
      colDef(name = col, align = "right", minWidth = 90, footer = make_footer(col))
    } else {
      colDef(name = col, align = "left", minWidth = 180,
             footer = if (has_total) function(values, name) tags$b("Total", style = "color:#fff;") else NULL)
    }
  })
  names(col_defs) <- names(df)

  flagged_amber <- highlight_rows
  flagged_red   <- if (na_leer_row && label_col == "Status") "NA / leer" else NULL

  row_style_fn <- if (!is.null(flagged_amber) || !is.null(flagged_red)) {
    bg_a  <- highlight_bg;    fg_a <- highlight_color
    bg_r  <- "#fde8e8";       fg_r <- "#c0392b"
    lbl   <- label_col
    fa    <- flagged_amber;   fr   <- flagged_red
    function(index) {
      val <- data_rows[[lbl]][index]
      if (!is.null(fr) && val %in% fr)
        list(background = bg_r, color = fg_r, fontWeight = "600",
             borderLeft = paste0("3px solid ", fg_r))
      else if (!is.null(fa) && val %in% fa)
        list(background = bg_a, color = fg_a, fontWeight = "600",
             borderLeft = paste0("3px solid ", fg_a))
      else list()
    }
  } else NULL

  tbl <- reactable(
    data_rows,
    columns         = col_defs,
    rowStyle        = row_style_fn,
    filterable      = TRUE,
    sortable        = TRUE,
    striped         = TRUE,
    highlight       = TRUE,
    bordered        = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    theme = reactableTheme(
      headerStyle  = list(background = "#2c3e50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold"),
      stripedColor = "#f8f9fa",
      footerStyle  = list(background = "#2c3e50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold")
    )
  )

  tagList(
    if (!is.null(title)) tags$p(tags$strong(title), style = "margin-bottom:4px; font-size:1.05em;"),
    tbl
  )
}

na_status_callout <- function(df, col = "Status") {
  # accepts either a pre-grouped summary (with Total col) or raw infopoints
  if (!("Total" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df |>
      na_label(col) |>
      group_by(.data[[col]]) |>
      summarise(Total = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
      rename(Status = all_of(col))
  } else {
    df <- df |> na_label(col) |> rename(Status = all_of(col))
  }
  na_row <- df |> filter(Status == "NA / leer")
  if (nrow(na_row) > 0 && na_row$Total > 0) {
    cat(paste0(
      "\n::: {.callout-warning}\n",
      "## ⚠️ Infopoints ohne Status\n",
      "**", na_row$Total, " Infopoints** in dieser Tabelle haben keinen Status-Eintrag (`NA / leer`). ",
      "Diese sollten bereinigt werden.\n",
      ":::\n"
    ))
  }
}

download_btn <- function(summary_df, raw_df, filename_summary, filename_raw) {
  make_csv_uri <- function(df) {
    csv_text <- paste(
      capture.output(write.csv(df, stdout(), row.names = FALSE)),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
    encoded <- base64enc::base64encode(charToRaw(csv_text))
    paste0("data:text/csv;base64,", encoded)
  }

  uri_summary <- make_csv_uri(summary_df)
  uri_raw     <- make_csv_uri(raw_df)

  btn_style <- paste0(
    "display:inline-block; margin:4px 6px 12px 0;",
    "padding:5px 12px; font-size:0.8em; border-radius:4px;",
    "border:none; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; color:white;"
  )

  tagList(
    tags$a(href = uri_summary, download = filename_summary,
           style = paste0(btn_style, "background:#2c3e50;"), "⬇ Tabelle (CSV)"),
    tags$a(href = uri_raw,     download = filename_raw,
           style = paste0(btn_style, "background:#18bc9c;"), "⬇ Rohdaten (CSV)")
  )
}
```

```{=html}
<button id="toggle-btn" onclick="toggleAll()">Alles einklappen</button>

<script>
let allCollapsed = false;

function toggleAll() {
  allCollapsed = !allCollapsed;
  document.querySelectorAll('.section-body').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.toggle('collapsed', allCollapsed);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.section-toggle').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.toggle('collapsed', allCollapsed);
  });
  document.getElementById('toggle-btn').textContent =
    allCollapsed ? 'Alles ausklappen' : 'Alles einklappen';
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const content = document.querySelector('.page-columns') ||
                  document.querySelector('main') ||
                  document.body;

  const headers = content.querySelectorAll('h3, h4');
  headers.forEach(header => {
    header.classList.add('section-toggle');
    const level = parseInt(header.tagName[1]);
    const body  = document.createElement('div');
    body.classList.add('section-body');
    body.style.maxHeight = '9999px';

    let next = header.nextElementSibling;
    while (next) {
      const nextLevel = next.tagName && next.tagName.match(/^H([34])$/)
        ? parseInt(next.tagName[1]) : null;
      if (nextLevel && nextLevel <= level) break;
      const tmp = next.nextElementSibling;
      body.appendChild(next);
      next = tmp;
    }

    header.parentNode.insertBefore(body, header.nextSibling);
    header.addEventListener('click', function() {
      body.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      header.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      body.style.maxHeight = body.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '0' : '9999px';
    });

    // default: collapsed
    body.classList.add('collapsed');
    body.style.maxHeight = '0';
    header.classList.add('collapsed');
  });

  allCollapsed = true;
  document.getElementById('toggle-btn').textContent = 'Alles ausklappen';
});
</script>
```

```{r exec-summary-data}
# --- Missing / flagged Status ---
n_no_status            <- sum(is.na(infopoints$Status) | infopoints$Status == "")
n_no_response          <- sum(str_to_lower(str_trim(infopoints$Status)) == "no response", na.rm = TRUE)
n_built_yes_no_receive <- infopoints |>
  filter(built == "Yes" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive")) |> nrow()

# --- Status counts for Status-Verteilung KPI group ---
n_status_receive     <- sum(infopoints$Status == "receive",     na.rm = TRUE)
n_status_open        <- sum(infopoints$Status == "open",        na.rm = TRUE)
n_status_applied     <- sum(infopoints$Status == "applied for", na.rm = TRUE)
n_status_rejected    <- sum(infopoints$Status == "rejected",    na.rm = TRUE)
n_status_no_response <- sum(str_to_lower(str_trim(infopoints$Status)) == "no response", na.rm = TRUE)
n_status_na          <- sum(is.na(infopoints$Status) | infopoints$Status == "")

# --- Abgeltungen: Datenchecks ---
n_payment_yes         <- sum(infopoints$`Payment required` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
n_payment_yes_no_cost <- infopoints |>
  filter(`Payment required` == "Yes" & (is.na(Costs) | Costs == "")) |> nrow()
costs_format_issues   <- infopoints |>
  filter(!is.na(Costs) & Costs != "") |>
  filter(str_detect(Costs, "x|\\(|€.*€")) |> nrow()
n_costs_but_no_pay    <- infopoints |>
  filter(!is.na(Costs_numeric) & Costs_numeric > 0 & `Payment required` == "No") |> nrow()

# --- Abgeltungen: Qualifikationstrichter (Payment = Yes als Basis) ---
pay_yes_exec          <- infopoints |> filter(`Payment required` == "Yes")
n_qualifiziert        <- pay_yes_exec |> filter(built == "Yes" & Status == "receive") |> nrow()
n_nicht_gebaut_no_rcv <- pay_yes_exec |> filter(built != "Yes" & Status != "receive") |> nrow()
n_gebaut_no_rcv       <- pay_yes_exec |> filter(built == "Yes" & Status != "receive") |> nrow()
n_rcv_no_built        <- pay_yes_exec |> filter(built != "Yes" & Status == "receive") |> nrow()

# --- Abgeltungen: Aktionsgruppen (receive + built) ---
recv_built_exec   <- infopoints |> filter(Status == "receive" & built == "Yes")
n_recv_built_exec <- nrow(recv_built_exec)
n_gruppe_a        <- recv_built_exec |> filter(`Payment required` == "Yes" & !is.na(Costs_numeric) & Costs_numeric > 0) |> nrow()
n_gruppe_b        <- recv_built_exec |> filter(`Payment required` == "Yes" & (is.na(Costs_numeric) | Costs_numeric == 0)) |> nrow()

# --- Built ---
n_built_leer           <- sum(is.na(infopoints$built) | infopoints$built == "")
n_built_yes_no_receive <- infopoints |>
  filter(built == "Yes" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive")) |> nrow()

# --- Applied for ---
applied_for_exec <- infopoints |>
  filter(Status == "applied for") |>
  mutate(
    requested_on = as.Date(`Requested on`, format = "%d.%m.%Y"),
    days_open    = as.numeric(today - requested_on),
    weeks_open   = days_open / 7
  )
n_applied_for     <- nrow(applied_for_exec)
n_applied_over12w <- sum(applied_for_exec$weeks_open >= 12, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- HP dahinter ---
n_hp_leer_exec <- infopoints |>
  filter(is.na(`HP behind`) | str_trim(`HP behind`) == "") |>
  filter(!str_detect(str_to_lower(`Deviations`), "\\bvon\\b")) |> nrow()

# --- Parcel ---
n_missing_all_parcel <- infopoints |>
  filter(
    (is.na(`Lot number`)       | `Lot number`       == "") &
    (is.na(`Folio number`)     | `Folio number`     == "") &
    (is.na(`Cadastral Number`) | `Cadastral Number` == "")
  ) |> nrow()

# ── Feeder ohne LR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Total: all Feeder-level infopoints not yet at Status = receive
n_feeder_no_lr <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive")) |>
  nrow()

# Broken down by Bau_Planung phase (all three phases present in the data)
n_feeder_no_lr_planung    <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         Bau_Planung == "Planung") |> nrow()
n_feeder_no_lr_im_bau     <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         Bau_Planung == "im Bau") |> nrow()
n_feeder_no_lr_bau_fertig <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         Bau_Planung == "Bau fertig") |> nrow()

# ── Feeder gebaut ohne LR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Total: subset of above that's also already built
n_feeder_built_no_lr <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         built == "Yes") |>
  nrow()

# Broken down by Bau_Planung phase
n_feeder_built_no_lr_planung    <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         built == "Yes" & Bau_Planung == "Planung") |> nrow()
n_feeder_built_no_lr_im_bau     <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         built == "Yes" & Bau_Planung == "im Bau") |> nrow()
n_feeder_built_no_lr_bau_fertig <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") &
         built == "Yes" & Bau_Planung == "Bau fertig") |> nrow()
```

```{r exec-kpi-boxes}
kpi_box <- function(val, lbl, cls = "") {
  tags$div(class = paste("kpi-box", cls),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-val", val),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-lbl", lbl)
  )
}
# Status box: number on line 1, % on line 2, label on line 3
kpi_box_status <- function(n, pct_val, lbl, cls = "") {
  tags$div(class = paste("kpi-box", cls),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-val", n),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-pct", paste0(pct_val, "%")),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-lbl", lbl)
  )
}
# Gesamt box: bold label via extra CSS class
kpi_box_gesamt <- function(val, lbl, cls = "") {
  tags$div(class = paste("kpi-box gesamt", cls),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-val", val),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-lbl", lbl)
  )
}
# Visual divider between feeder sub-groups
kpi_divider <- function() tags$div(class = "kpi-divider")

kpi_group <- function(label, ...) {
  tags$div(class = "kpi-section",
    tags$div(class = "kpi-section-label", label),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-grid", ...)
  )
}

tagList(
  # ── Datenbestand ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kpi_group("Datenbestand",
    kpi_box(n_total_all,
            "Infopoints gesamt (alle Projekte inkl. on hold)"),
    kpi_box(n_total_active,
            paste0("In aktiven Projekten — ohne on hold (", n_projects_all, " Projekten)")),
    kpi_box(n_canceled,
            paste0("Davon storniert (", round(100 * n_canceled / n_total_active, 1), "% der aktiven inkl. storniert)"),
            "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_total,
            paste0("Analyse-Basis: aktiv & nicht storniert (", round(100 * n_total / n_total_active, 1), "% der aktiven inkl. storniert)"),
            "ok")
  ),

  # ── Infopunkte je Status ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  kpi_group("Infopunkte je Status",
    kpi_box_status(n_status_receive,
                   round(100 * n_status_receive     / n_total, 1),
                   "receive"),
    kpi_box_status(n_status_open,
                   round(100 * n_status_open        / n_total, 1),
                   "open"),
    kpi_box_status(n_status_applied,
                   round(100 * n_status_applied     / n_total, 1),
                   paste0("applied for — davon ", n_applied_over12w,
                          " (", round(100 * n_applied_over12w / max(n_applied_for, 1), 1),
                          "%) > 12 Wochen offen")),
    kpi_box_status(n_status_rejected,
                   round(100 * n_status_rejected    / n_total, 1),
                   "rejected",    "warn"),
    kpi_box_status(n_status_no_response,
                   round(100 * n_status_no_response / n_total, 1),
                   "no response", "warn"),
    kpi_box_status(n_status_na,
                   round(100 * n_status_na          / n_total, 1),
                   "NA / leer",   "warn")
  ),

  # ── Datenqualität ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kpi_group("Datenqualität",
    kpi_box(n_hp_leer_exec,
            paste0("HP behind fehlt (", round(100 * n_hp_leer_exec / n_total, 1), "% ohne storniert)"),
            "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_missing_all_parcel,
            paste0("Alle 3 Katasterfelder fehlen (", round(100 * n_missing_all_parcel / n_total, 1), "% ohne storniert)"),
            "warn")
  ),

  # ── Leitungsrechte ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kpi_group("Leitungsrechte",
    kpi_box(n_built_yes_no_receive,
            paste0("Gebaut, aber Status ≠ receive (", round(100 * n_built_yes_no_receive / n_total, 1), "% ohne storniert)"),
            "warn"),
    kpi_divider(),
    kpi_box_gesamt(n_feeder_no_lr,
                   "Feeder ohne LR (gesamt)", "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_feeder_no_lr_planung,
            "Feeder ohne LR — Planung", "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_feeder_no_lr_im_bau,
            "Feeder ohne LR — im Bau", "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_feeder_no_lr_bau_fertig,
            "Feeder ohne LR — Bau fertig", "warn"),
    kpi_divider(),
    kpi_box_gesamt(n_feeder_built_no_lr,
                   "Feeder gebaut ohne LR (gesamt)", "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_feeder_built_no_lr_planung,
            "Feeder gebaut ohne LR — Planung", "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_feeder_built_no_lr_im_bau,
            "Feeder gebaut ohne LR — im Bau", "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_feeder_built_no_lr_bau_fertig,
            "Feeder gebaut ohne LR — Bau fertig", "warn")
  ),

  # ── Abgeltungen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kpi_group("Abgeltungen",
    kpi_box(n_payment_yes,
            paste0("Payment required = Yes (", round(100 * n_payment_yes / n_total, 1), "% ohne storniert)"),
            "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_qualifiziert,
            paste0("Qualifiziert: Built & receive (", round(100 * n_qualifiziert / n_payment_yes, 1), "% der Abgeltungen)"),
            "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_gruppe_a,
            paste0("A — Zahlen & payed setzen (", round(100 * n_gruppe_a / max(n_recv_built_exec, 1), 1), "% von receive+gebaut)"),
            "warn"),
    kpi_box(n_gruppe_b,
            paste0("B — Klären: Costs leer (", round(100 * n_gruppe_b / max(n_recv_built_exec, 1), 1), "% von receive+gebaut)"),
            "warn")
  )
)
```

::: {.callout-note}
Alle Zahlen und Prozentangaben beziehen sich auf **`r n_total` aktive, nicht stornierte Infopoints** in `r n_projects_all` Projekten (ohne on hold). Ausgefiltert: `r n_canceled` storniert + `r n_total_all - n_total_active` in on hold Projekten.
:::

## Kapitel 1: Status-Übersicht nach Projekt

Übersicht aller Infopoints nach Bau/Planung-Status, PB, LR-Akquise und Projekt — aufgeschlüsselt nach den möglichen Status-Werten. Stornierte Infopoints sind hier zur Vollständigkeit mitgezeigt; in allen anderen Kapiteln sind sie ausgeschlossen.

### 1.1 Status-Übersicht nach Projekt

```{r status-overview-by-project}
# Include canceled here for the overview table (shown as reference)
status_cols <- c("open", "applied for", "receive", "rejected", "no response", "canceled")

status_overview <- infopoints_active |>
  na_label() |>
  group_by(Bau_Planung, PB, LR_Akquise, `Planned by`) |>
  summarise(
    Leer            = sum(Status == "NA / leer",    na.rm = TRUE),
    open            = sum(Status == "open",          na.rm = TRUE),
    `applied for`   = sum(Status == "applied for",  na.rm = TRUE),
    receive         = sum(Status == "receive",       na.rm = TRUE),
    rejected        = sum(Status == "rejected",      na.rm = TRUE),
    `no response`   = sum(Status == "no response",  na.rm = TRUE),
    canceled        = sum(Status == "canceled",      na.rm = TRUE),
    Gesamt          = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Bau_Planung, `Planned by`) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(-c(Bau_Planung, PB, LR_Akquise, `Planned by`), as.numeric))
```

```{r status-overview-table}
reactable(
  status_overview |> filter(Bau_Planung != "Total"),
  columns = list(
    Bau_Planung   = colDef(name = "Bau/Planung", minWidth = 90,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b("Total", style="color:#fff")),
    PB            = colDef(name = "PB",          minWidth = 80,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b("", style="color:#fff")),
    LR_Akquise    = colDef(name = "LR-Akquise",  minWidth = 90,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b("", style="color:#fff")),
    `Planned by`  = colDef(name = "Projekt",     minWidth = 200,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b("", style="color:#fff")),
    Leer          = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 60,
                           style = function(v) if (!is.na(v) && v > 0) list(color = "#e67e22", fontWeight = "bold") else list(),
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$Leer[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    open          = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 60,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$open[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    `applied for` = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 80,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$`applied for`[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    receive       = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 70,
                           style = function(v) if (!is.na(v) && v > 0) list(color = "#18bc9c", fontWeight = "bold") else list(),
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$receive[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    rejected      = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 70,
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$rejected[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    `no response` = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 90,
                           style = function(v) if (!is.na(v) && v > 0) list(color = "#8e44ad") else list(),
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$`no response`[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    canceled      = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 75,
                           style = function(v) if (!is.na(v) && v > 0) list(color = "#95a5a6") else list(),
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$canceled[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff")),
    Gesamt        = colDef(align = "right", minWidth = 70,
                           style = list(fontWeight = "bold"),
                           footer = function(v, n) tags$b(sum(status_overview$Gesamt[status_overview$Bau_Planung == "Total"], na.rm=TRUE), style="color:#fff"))
  ),
  filterable      = TRUE,
  sortable        = TRUE,
  striped         = TRUE,
  highlight       = TRUE,
  bordered        = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 30,
  theme = reactableTheme(
    headerStyle = list(background = "#2c3e50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold"),
    stripedColor = "#f8f9fa",
    footerStyle  = list(background = "#2c3e50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold")
  )
)
```

```{r dl-status-overview}
download_btn(
  summary_df       = status_overview,
  raw_df           = infopoints_active |>
    select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, Bau_Planung, PB, LR_Akquise, Status),
  filename_summary = "1-1_status_overview_summary.csv",
  filename_raw     = "1-1_status_overview_raw.csv"
)
```

```{r status-building-type}
status_by_building_type <- infopoints |>
  na_label() |>
  group_by(Status, `Building Type`) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Building Type`, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  add_col_totals() |>
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) |>
  relocate(Total, .after = Status) |>
  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total")
```

#### 1.3.1 Fehlende FeederDrop-Informationen nach Projekt

Projekte, bei denen Infopoints keinen FeederDrop Level eingetragen haben (weder Drop Level noch Feeder Level).

```{r feederdrop-missing-by-project}
feederdrop_missing_by_project <- infopoints |>
  group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(
    Total          = n(),
    `Drop Level`   = sum(`FeederDrop Level` == "Drop Level",   na.rm = TRUE),
    `Feeder Level` = sum(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level", na.rm = TRUE),
    `NA`           = sum(is.na(`FeederDrop Level`) | `FeederDrop Level` == ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(`NA` > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(`NA`)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(c(Total, `Drop Level`, `Feeder Level`, `NA`), as.numeric)) |>
  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total")

feederdrop_missing_by_pb <- infopoints |>
  group_by(PB) |>
  summarise(
    Total          = n(),
    `Drop Level`   = sum(`FeederDrop Level` == "Drop Level",   na.rm = TRUE),
    `Feeder Level` = sum(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level", na.rm = TRUE),
    `NA`           = sum(is.na(`FeederDrop Level`) | `FeederDrop Level` == ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(`NA` > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(`NA`)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(c(Total, `Drop Level`, `Feeder Level`, `NA`), as.numeric)) |>
  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total")
```

```{r payment-yes-no-costs}
payment_yes_no_costs  <- infopoints |>
  filter(`Payment required` == "Yes" & (is.na(Costs) | Costs == ""))

n_payment_yes_no_costs <- nrow(payment_yes_no_costs)
```


::: {.callout-warning}
**Hinweis Kostenformat:** Es wurden `r pct(n_costs_format_issues)` Zeilen mit nicht-standardisierten Kostenformaten gefunden (z.B. `482,80 € (2x 241,40€)`). Diese sollten manuell geprüft werden, falls gewünscht.
:::

---

#### 2.1.3 Abgeltungen: Qualifikationsstatus nach Projekt

Infopoints mit **Payment required = Yes** — Fortschrittstrichter pro Projekt. Eine Abgeltung gilt als **vollständig qualifiziert**, wenn beide Bedingungen erfüllt sind: `Built = Yes` **und** `Status = receive`. Nicht qualifizierte Infopoints werden nach Ablehnungsgrund aufgeschlüsselt.

- **Nicht gebaut & kein receive**: weder gebaut noch Status = receive (kein Fortschritt)
- **Gebaut, kein receive**: gebaut, aber Status noch nicht auf "receive" gesetzt
- **Receive, nicht gebaut**: Status = receive, aber `built` noch nicht = Yes
- **Qualifiziert (Built & receive)**: beide Bedingungen erfüllt → Abgeltung auszahlungsbereit

```{r abgeltung-receive-by-project}
abgeltung_by_project <- pay_yes_exec |>
  group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(
    `Payment = Yes`                  = n(),
    `Qualifiziert (Built & receive)` = sum(built == "Yes" & Status == "receive", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Nicht gebaut & kein receive`    = sum(built != "Yes" & Status != "receive", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Gebaut, kein receive`           = sum(built == "Yes" & Status != "receive", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Receive, nicht gebaut`          = sum(built != "Yes" & Status == "receive", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(`Payment = Yes`)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(-c(`Planned by`, PB), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    `Qualifiziert %`                  = round(100 * `Qualifiziert (Built & receive)` / `Payment = Yes`, 1),
    `Nicht gebaut & kein receive %`   = round(100 * `Nicht gebaut & kein receive`    / `Payment = Yes`, 1),
    `Gebaut, kein receive %`          = round(100 * `Gebaut, kein receive`            / `Payment = Yes`, 1),
    `Receive, nicht gebaut %`         = round(100 * `Receive, nicht gebaut`           / `Payment = Yes`, 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    `Planned by`, PB,
    `Payment = Yes`,
    `Qualifiziert (Built & receive)`, `Qualifiziert %`,
    `Nicht gebaut & kein receive`,    `Nicht gebaut & kein receive %`,
    `Gebaut, kein receive`,           `Gebaut, kein receive %`,
    `Receive, nicht gebaut`,          `Receive, nicht gebaut %`
  )
```

```{r abgeltung-receive-table}
rt(abgeltung_by_project, title = "Abgeltungen nach Projekt: Qualifikationsstatus")
```

```{r dl-abgeltung-receive}
download_btn(
  summary_df       = abgeltung_by_project,
  raw_df           = pay_yes_exec |>
    select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, PB, Status, built, Costs, Costs_numeric),
  filename_summary = "1-1-3_abgeltung_qualifikation_summary.csv",
  filename_raw     = "1-1-3_abgeltung_qualifikation_raw.csv"
)
```

---

#### 2.1.4 Abgeltungen: Handlungsbedarf — receive + gebaut

Infopoints mit `Status = receive` **und** `Built = Yes` — LR bereits erhalten, Infopoint gebaut. Aufgeteilt nach zwei Aktionsgruppen basierend auf den Kostendaten. Gruppe B enthält per Filter auch Einträge mit `Payment required = No` (kein Geld fällig, können direkt bereinigt werden).

::: {.callout-note}
**Gruppe A — Zahlen & "payed" setzen:** `Payment required = Yes` und `Costs > 0` → Rechnung liegt vor, Abgeltung ist fällig. Status auf "payed" setzen.

**Gruppe B — Klären:** `Payment required = Yes` und `Costs leer` → Unklar ob wirklich keine Kosten anfallen oder ob das Feld vergessen wurde. Manuell prüfen. _Tipp: mit dem Filter auf `Payment required = No` einschränken um Einträge zu finden, die wir selbst bereinigen können._
:::

```{r abgeltung-action-data}
# Base: receive + built
recv_built <- infopoints |>
  filter(Status == "receive" & built == "Yes")

n_recv_built <- nrow(recv_built)

# Per-project breakdown: A and B only
action_by_project <- recv_built |>
  group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(
    `Receive & Built` = n(),
    `A: Zahlen`       = sum(`Payment required` == "Yes" & !is.na(Costs_numeric) & Costs_numeric > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    `B: Klären`       = sum(`Payment required` == "Yes" & (is.na(Costs_numeric) | Costs_numeric == 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(`Receive & Built` > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(`Receive & Built`)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(-c(`Planned by`, PB), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    `A: Zahlen %` = round(100 * `A: Zahlen` / `Receive & Built`, 1),
    `B: Klären %` = round(100 * `B: Klären` / `Receive & Built`, 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    `Planned by`, PB, `Receive & Built`,
    `A: Zahlen`, `A: Zahlen %`,
    `B: Klären`, `B: Klären %`
  )
```

**Basis: `r n_recv_built` Infopoints** mit Status = receive und Built = Yes.

```{r abgeltung-action-project-table}
rt(action_by_project, title = "Handlungsbedarf nach Projekt (receive + gebaut)")
```

```{r dl-action-project}
download_btn(
  summary_df       = action_by_project,
  raw_df           = recv_built |>
    select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, PB, Status, built, `Payment required`, Costs, Costs_numeric),
  filename_summary = "1-1-4_action_project_summary.csv",
  filename_raw     = "1-1-4_action_project_raw.csv"
)
```

### 2.2 Built Yes/No — Datencheck

#### 2.2.1 Status von "built" pro Projekt

```{r built-by-project}
built_summary <- infopoints |>
  group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(
    Total         = n(),
    `Built: Yes`  = sum(built == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Built: No`   = sum(built == "No",  na.rm = TRUE),
    `Built: leer` = sum(is.na(built) | built == ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(`Planned by`) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(c(`Built: Yes`, `Built: No`, `Built: leer`), as.numeric)) |>
  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total")

projects_always_no  <- infopoints |> group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(Total = n(), `Built: No`  = sum(built == "No",  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(`Built: No`  == Total)
projects_always_yes <- infopoints |> group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(Total = n(), `Built: Yes` = sum(built == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(`Built: Yes` == Total)
projects_zero_yes   <- infopoints |> group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(Total = n(), `Built: Yes` = sum(built == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(`Built: Yes` == 0)
projects_zero_no    <- infopoints |> group_by(`Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(Total = n(), `Built: No`  = sum(built == "No",  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(`Built: No`  == 0)

n_projects_always_no  <- nrow(projects_always_no)
n_projects_always_yes <- nrow(projects_always_yes)
n_projects_zero_yes   <- nrow(projects_zero_yes)
n_projects_zero_no    <- nrow(projects_zero_no)
n_projects            <- n_distinct(infopoints$`Planned by`)
```

**Zusammenfassung über alle `r n_projects` Projekte:**

| Kennzahl | Anzahl Projekte |
|---|---|
| 0 "Yes" (kein einziger gebaut) | `r n_projects_zero_yes` |
| 0 "No" (alle gebaut oder offen) | `r n_projects_zero_no` |
| 100% "Yes" (alle gebaut) | `r n_projects_always_yes` |
| 100% "No" (keiner gebaut) | `r n_projects_always_no` |

## Kapitel 3: Zeitkomponente — "Applied for" & "Open"


Dieses Kapitel analysiert, wie lange Infopoints in den Status **"applied for"** und **"open"** verbleiben — für "applied for" gemessen ab dem Datum in "Requested on", für "open" ab dem Datum in "Creation time", jeweils bis heute (`r today`).

```{r applied-for-base}
applied_for <- infopoints |>
  filter(Status == "applied for") |>
  mutate(
    requested_on = as.Date(`Requested on`, format = "%d.%m.%Y"),
    days_open    = as.numeric(today - requested_on),
    weeks_open   = days_open / 7,
    missing_date = is.na(requested_on)
  )

n_applied_for      <- nrow(applied_for)
n_missing_date     <- sum(applied_for$missing_date)
n_with_date        <- n_applied_for - n_missing_date
n_projects_total   <- n_distinct(infopoints$`Planned by`, na.rm = TRUE)
n_projects_applied <- n_distinct(applied_for$`Planned by`, na.rm = TRUE)

applied_for_dated <- applied_for |> filter(!missing_date)
```

### 3.1 Übersicht: "Applied for"

**Gesamtanzahl Infopoints mit Status "applied for":** `r pct(n_applied_for)`

**Davon ohne Datum in "Requested on":** `r n_missing_date` (`r round(100 * n_missing_date / n_applied_for, 1)`%)

**Davon mit Datum in "Requested on":** `r n_with_date` (`r round(100 * n_with_date / n_applied_for, 1)`%)

```{r applied-for-missing-date-callout, results='asis'}
if (n_missing_date > 0) {
  cat(paste0(
    "\n::: {.callout-warning}\n",
    "## ⚠️ Fehlende Datumsangaben\n",
    "**", n_missing_date, " Infopoints** haben den Status \"applied for\", aber kein Datum in \"Requested on\". ",
    "Diese können nicht in die Zeitanalyse einbezogen werden und sollten manuell geprüft werden.\n",
    ":::\n"
  ))
}
```

**Projekte mit mindestens einem "applied for" Infopoint:** `r n_projects_applied` von `r n_projects_total` Projekten (`r round(100 * n_projects_applied / n_projects_total, 1)`%)

Anzahl der Infopoints je Wartezeitklasse (nur Infopoints mit gültigem Datum, n = `r n_with_date`).

```{r applied-for-thresholds}
threshold_summary <- tibble(
  `Schwellenwert`     = c("< 4 Wochen", "4–8 Wochen", "8–12 Wochen", "> 12 Wochen"),
  `Anzahl Infopoints` = c(
    sum(applied_for_dated$weeks_open <  4),
    sum(applied_for_dated$weeks_open >= 4  & applied_for_dated$weeks_open <  8),
    sum(applied_for_dated$weeks_open >= 8  & applied_for_dated$weeks_open < 12),
    sum(applied_for_dated$weeks_open >= 12)
  )
) |>
  mutate(`Anzahl Infopoints %` = round(100 * `Anzahl Infopoints` / n_with_date, 1))
```

```{r applied-for-thresholds-table}
rt(threshold_summary, title = "Offene 'Applied for' Infopoints nach Wartezeit")
```

```{r dl-thresholds}
download_btn(
  summary_df       = threshold_summary,
  raw_df           = applied_for_dated |>
    select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, `Requested on`, requested_on, days_open, weeks_open),
  filename_summary = "2-2_applied_for_wartezeit_summary.csv",
  filename_raw     = "2-2_applied_for_wartezeit_raw.csv"
)
```

### 3.3 Histogramm: Wartezeit seit "applied for"

Verteilung der Wochen seit Statussetzen auf "applied for" für alle Infopoints mit gültigem Datum (n = `r n_with_date`). Maximaler Wert: **`r round(max(applied_for_dated$weeks_open, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` Wochen** (`r round(max(applied_for_dated$days_open, na.rm = TRUE))` Tage).

```{r applied-for-histogram, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, out.width='100%'}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2)

max_weeks <- max(applied_for_dated$weeks_open, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(applied_for_dated, aes(x = weeks_open)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 4,
    fill     = "#2c3e50",
    color    = "white",
    alpha    = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 12, color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 13, y = Inf, label = "12 Wochen\nSchwelle",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, color = "#e67e22", size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max_weeks / 4) * 4, by = 4),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "W")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Wartezeit seit 'applied for' (max: ", round(max_weeks, 1), " Wochen)"),
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_with_date, " Infopoints mit gültigem Datum | Balkenbreite = 4 Wochen"),
    x        = "Wochen offen",
    y        = "Anzahl Infopoints"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#666"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 9, angle = 0)
  )
```

### 3.4 Übersicht: "Open"

Verteilung der Wochen seit Erstellung für alle Infopoints mit Status **"open"**, gemessen ab dem Datum in "Creation time" bis heute (`r today`).

```{r open-base}
open_ip <- infopoints |>
  filter(str_to_lower(str_trim(Status)) == "open") |>
  mutate(
    creation_date = as.Date(`Creation time`, format = "%d.%m.%Y"),
    days_open     = as.numeric(today - creation_date),
    weeks_open    = days_open / 7,
    missing_date  = is.na(creation_date)
  )

n_open           <- nrow(open_ip)
n_open_missing   <- sum(open_ip$missing_date)
n_open_with_date <- n_open - n_open_missing
open_dated       <- open_ip |> filter(!missing_date)
```

**Gesamtanzahl Infopoints mit Status "open":** `r pct(n_open)`

**Davon ohne Datum in "Creation time":** `r n_open_missing` (`r round(100 * n_open_missing / max(n_open, 1), 1)`%)

**Davon mit Datum in "Creation time":** `r n_open_with_date` (`r round(100 * n_open_with_date / max(n_open, 1), 1)`%)

```{r open-missing-date-callout, results='asis'}
if (n_open_missing > 0) {
  cat(paste0(
    "\n::: {.callout-warning}\n",
    "## ⚠️ Fehlende Datumsangaben\n",
    "**", n_open_missing, " Infopoints** haben den Status \"open\", aber kein Datum in \"Creation time\". ",
    "Diese können nicht in die Zeitanalyse einbezogen werden und sollten manuell geprüft werden.\n",
    ":::\n"
  ))
}
```

Anzahl der Infopoints je Wartezeitklasse (nur Infopoints mit gültigem Datum, n = `r n_open_with_date`).

```{r open-thresholds}
open_threshold_summary <- tibble(
  `Schwellenwert`     = c("< 4 Wochen", "4–8 Wochen", "8–12 Wochen", "> 12 Wochen"),
  `Anzahl Infopoints` = c(
    sum(open_dated$weeks_open <  4),
    sum(open_dated$weeks_open >= 4  & open_dated$weeks_open <  8),
    sum(open_dated$weeks_open >= 8  & open_dated$weeks_open < 12),
    sum(open_dated$weeks_open >= 12)
  )
) |>
  mutate(`Anzahl Infopoints %` = round(100 * `Anzahl Infopoints` / max(n_open_with_date, 1), 1))
```

```{r open-thresholds-table}
rt(open_threshold_summary, title = "Offene 'Open' Infopoints nach Wartezeit")
```

### 3.5 Aufschlüsselung nach Projekt

```{r open-by-project}
open_by_project <- open_ip |>
  group_by(Bau_Planung, `Planned by`, PB) |>
  summarise(
    `Total open`  = n(),
    `Kein Datum`  = sum(missing_date),
    `< 4 Wochen`  = sum(!missing_date & weeks_open <  4),
    `4–8 Wochen`  = sum(!missing_date & weeks_open >= 4  & weeks_open <  8),
    `8–12 Wochen` = sum(!missing_date & weeks_open >= 8  & weeks_open < 12),
    `> 12 Wochen` = sum(!missing_date & weeks_open >= 12),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Bau_Planung, desc(`Total open`)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>

  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total open")
```

### 3.6 Histogramm: Wartezeit seit "open"

Maximaler Wert: **`r round(max(open_dated$weeks_open, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` Wochen** (`r round(max(open_dated$days_open, na.rm = TRUE))` Tage).

```{r open-histogram, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, out.width='100%'}
max_weeks_open <- max(open_dated$weeks_open, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(open_dated, aes(x = weeks_open)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 4,
    fill     = "#2c3e50",
    color    = "white",
    alpha    = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 12, color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 13, y = Inf, label = "12 Wochen\nSchwelle",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, color = "#e67e22", size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max_weeks_open / 4) * 4, by = 4),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "W")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Wartezeit seit Erstellung mit Status 'open' (max: ", round(max_weeks_open, 1), " Wochen)"),
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_open_with_date, " Infopoints mit gültigem Datum | Balkenbreite = 4 Wochen"),
    x        = "Wochen offen",
    y        = "Anzahl Infopoints"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#666"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 9, angle = 0)
  )
```

```{r dl-open}
)
```

## Kapitel 4: Bau/Planung-Kontext

Dieses Kapitel analysiert Datenqualitätsprobleme **im Kontext des Bau/Planung-Status** der jeweiligen Projekte. Issues in Projekten mit Status **"Bau fertig"** sind dringlicher als solche in Projekten, die noch in Planung sind.

```{r bauplanung-setup}
# Bau_Planung is now on infopoints via the join
bau_levels <- infopoints |>
  filter(!is.na(Bau_Planung)) |>
  pull(Bau_Planung) |>
  unique() |>
  sort()
```

### 4.1 Überblick: Infopoints nach Bau/Planung-Status

```{r bauplanung-overview}
bauplanung_overview <- infopoints |>
  mutate(Bau_Planung = if_else(is.na(Bau_Planung) | Bau_Planung == "", "NA / leer", Bau_Planung)) |>
  group_by(Bau_Planung) |>
  summarise(
    Total              = n(),
    `Ohne Status`      = sum(is.na(Status) | Status == ""),
    `Built = Yes`      = sum(built == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Built = No`       = sum(built == "No",  na.rm = TRUE),
    `Payment = Yes`    = sum(`Payment required` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Applied for`      = sum(Status == "applied for",  na.rm = TRUE),
    `No response`      = sum(str_to_lower(str_trim(Status)) == "no response", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  add_col_totals() |>
  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total")
```

```{r bauplanung-overview-table}
rt(bauplanung_overview, title = "Infopoints nach Bau/Planung-Status")
```

```{r dl-bauplanung-overview}
download_btn(
  summary_df       = bauplanung_overview,
  raw_df           = infopoints |> select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, PB, Bau_Planung, Status, built, `Payment required`),
  filename_summary = "4-1_bauplanung_overview_summary.csv",
  filename_raw     = "4-1_bauplanung_overview_raw.csv"
)
```

---

### 4.2 Kritische Issues nach Bau/Planung-Status

Für jede Problemkategorie wird aufgezeigt, in welchem Bau/Planung-Status die betroffenen Infopoints liegen. Issues in weiter fortgeschrittenen Projekten ("Bau fertig") sind vorrangig zu behandeln.

#### 4.2.1 Gebaut, aber Status ≠ receive — nach Bau/Planung

```{r bauplanung-built-no-receive}
built_no_rcv_by_bp <- infopoints |>
  filter(built == "Yes" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive")) |>
  mutate(Bau_Planung = if_else(is.na(Bau_Planung) | Bau_Planung == "", "NA / leer", Bau_Planung)) |>
  group_by(Bau_Planung) |>
  summarise(
    `Anzahl`       = n(),
    `Projekte`     = n_distinct(`Planned by`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Anzahl)) |>
  mutate(`% von Gesamt` = round(100 * Anzahl / n_total, 1))
```

## Kapitel 5: Gebaut ohne Leitungsrecht

Infopoints mit `Built = Yes` **und** `Status ≠ receive` (fehlender Status zählt
hier als "≠ receive") — die physische Infrastruktur ist vorhanden, das
Leitungsrecht aber noch nicht gesichert. Basis: alle aktiven, nicht-stornierten
Infopoints (`r n_total`), gefiltert auf `Built = Yes`; davon ausgeschlossen
sind nur Infopoints mit `Status = receive`.

```{r built-no-lr-base}
built_no_lr   <- infopoints |>
  filter(built == "Yes" & (is.na(Status) | str_trim(Status) != "receive"))
n_built_no_lr <- nrow(built_no_lr)
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## ⚠️ Gebaut ohne gesichertes Leitungsrecht
**`r n_built_no_lr` Infopoints** (`r round(100 * n_built_no_lr / n_total, 1)`% aller
aktiven) sind gebaut, haben aber noch keinen `receive`-Status.
:::

```{r built-no-lr-by-status}
built_no_lr_by_status <- built_no_lr |>

  arrange(desc(Total)) |>
  add_col_totals() |>
  mutate(`% von Gesamt` = round(100 * Total / n_built_no_lr, 1))
```

### 5.4 Kreuztabelle: Status × FeederDrop Level

```{r built-no-lr-crosstab}
built_no_lr_crosstab <- built_no_lr |>
  na_label("Status") |>
  mutate(`FeederDrop Level` = if_else(
    is.na(`FeederDrop Level`) | str_trim(`FeederDrop Level`) == "",
    "NA / leer", `FeederDrop Level`
  )) |>
  group_by(Status, `FeederDrop Level`) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `FeederDrop Level`, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  add_col_totals() |>
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) |>
  relocate(Total, .after = Status) |>
  add_pct_cols(pct_base = "Total") |>
  arrange(desc(Total))
```

### 5.5 Aufschlüsselung nach Projekt

```{r built-no-lr-by-project}
built_no_lr_by_project <- built_no_lr |>
  mutate(`FeederDrop Level` = if_else(
    is.na(`FeederDrop Level`) | str_trim(`FeederDrop Level`) == "",
    "NA / leer", `FeederDrop Level`
  )) |>
  group_by(`Planned by`, PB, Bau_Planung, `FeederDrop Level`) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `FeederDrop Level`, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    `Drop Level`   = if ("Drop Level"   %in% names(pick(everything()))) `Drop Level`   else 0L,
    `Feeder Level` = if ("Feeder Level" %in% names(pick(everything()))) `Feeder Level` else 0L,
    `NA / leer`    = if ("NA / leer"    %in% names(pick(everything()))) `NA / leer`    else 0L
  ) |>
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) |>
  arrange(desc(Total)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(`% von Gesamt` = round(100 * Total / n_built_no_lr, 1))
```

```{r built-no-lr-metres-histogram, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, out.width='100%'}
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, fill = "#2c3e50", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max_m / 100) * 100, by = 100),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, " m")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Trassenlänge ohne Leitungsrecht (max: ", round(max_m), " m)"),
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_blr_metres, " Infopoints mit gültigem Wert | Balkenbreite = 50 m"),
    x        = "Trassenlänge (m)",
    y        = "Anzahl Infopoints"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#666"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Kapitel 6: LR im Zeitverlauf

Entwicklung der Infopoints je Status über die Zeit (wöchentlich), basierend
auf der Zusammenfassung in `LR-Statusentwicklung_piha_neu.xlsx`
(Tabellenblatt `Statusentwicklung`). Die Zahlen sind bereits um on-hold-
Projekte bereinigt (siehe Titel des Tabellenblatts).

```{r lr-status-history-load}
lr_status_history_raw <- read_excel(
  lr_status_history_path,
  sheet     = "Statusentwicklung",
  skip      = 1,
  col_names = TRUE
)

# Standardize column names by position — confirmed order: Datum, abgelehnt,
# angesucht, erhalten, offen, storniert, no response.
names(lr_status_history_raw)[1:7] <- c(
  "kw", "Abgelehnt", "Angesucht", "Erhalten", "Offen", "Storniert", "No_Response"
)

lr_status_history <- lr_status_history_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(kw) & kw != "") |>
  mutate(across(c(Abgelehnt, Angesucht, Erhalten, Offen, Storniert, No_Response),
                ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) |>
  mutate(kw_order = row_number())

n_lr_weeks <- nrow(lr_status_history)
```

::: {.callout-note}
Datengrundlage: **`r n_lr_weeks` Kalenderwochen** aus `Statusentwicklung`
(`r lr_status_history$kw[1]` bis `r lr_status_history$kw[n_lr_weeks]`). Zahlen
beziehen sich bereits auf aktive (nicht on-hold) Projekte gesamt — keine
Aufschlüsselung nach einzelnem Projekt in dieser Quelle verfügbar.
:::

### 6.1 Entwicklung nach Status

```{r lr-status-history-chart, fig.width=14, fig.height=7, out.width='100%'}
lr_status_long <- lr_status_history |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(Abgelehnt, Angesucht, Erhalten, Offen, Storniert, No_Response),
    names_to  = "Status",
    values_to = "Anzahl"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Status = factor(Status,
      levels = c("Abgelehnt", "Angesucht", "Erhalten", "Offen", "Storniert", "No_Response"),
      labels = c("Abgelehnt", "Angesucht", "Erhalten", "Offen", "Storniert", "No Response")
    ),
    kw = factor(kw, levels = lr_status_history$kw)
  )

status_colors <- c(
  "Abgelehnt"   = "#c0392b",
  "Angesucht"   = "#e67e22",
  "Erhalten"    = "#18bc9c",
  "Offen"       = "#3498db",
  "Storniert"   = "#7f8c8d",
  "No Response" = "#8e44ad"
)

lr_status_gg <- ggplot(
    lr_status_long,
    aes(x = kw, y = Anzahl, color = Status, group = Status,
        text = paste0(Status, ", ", kw, ": ", Anzahl))
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = status_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "LR-Status im Zeitverlauf",
    x     = "Kalenderwoche",
    y     = "Anzahl der LR",
    color = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggplotly(lr_status_gg, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.25))
```

## Kapitel 7: Projektseiten

Projekt auswählen, um die wichtigsten Kennzahlen ausschließlich für dieses
Projekt zu sehen: Status-Verteilung, FeederDrop Level, Built-Status und die
Zeitkomponente (applied for / open).

```{r project-pages-prep}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# All five metric views collapsed into tidy long-format tables, one row per
# (Planned by, category, count). The ojs side only filters by project and
# renders — no aggregation logic lives in JS.
#
# Alongside each, a matching *_detail table keeps the individual infopoint
# rows (not just counts) so a per-row download button can export exactly
# the infopoints behind that number.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ── helper: add baulos_name to any detail table ───────────────────────────
# Left join so infopoints without a Baulos match keep all their rows (baulos_name = NA)
add_baulos <- function(df) {
  df |> left_join(baulos_lookup |> select(`External ID`, baulos_name),
                  by = "External ID")
}

detail_cols <- c("External ID", "Planned by", "Status", "FeederDrop Level", "built", "HP behind")

pp_status <- infopoints |>
  na_label("Status") |>
  count(`Planned by`, Status, name = "n") |>
  rename(category = Status)

pp_status_detail <- infopoints |>
  na_label("Status") |>
  select(all_of(detail_cols)) |>
  mutate(category = Status) |>
  add_baulos()

pp_feederdrop <- infopoints |>
  mutate(`FeederDrop Level` = if_else(
    is.na(`FeederDrop Level`) | str_trim(`FeederDrop Level`) == "",
    "NA / leer", `FeederDrop Level`
  )) |>
  count(`Planned by`, `FeederDrop Level`, name = "n") |>
  rename(category = `FeederDrop Level`)

pp_feederdrop_detail <- infopoints |>
  mutate(`FeederDrop Level` = if_else(
    is.na(`FeederDrop Level`) | str_trim(`FeederDrop Level`) == "",
    "NA / leer", `FeederDrop Level`
  )) |>
  select(all_of(detail_cols)) |>
  mutate(category = `FeederDrop Level`) |>
  add_baulos()

pp_built <- infopoints |>
  mutate(built = if_else(is.na(built) | built == "", "NA / leer", built)) |>
  count(`Planned by`, built, name = "n") |>
  rename(category = built)

pp_built_detail <- infopoints |>
  mutate(built = if_else(is.na(built) | built == "", "NA / leer", built)) |>
  select(all_of(detail_cols)) |>
  mutate(category = built) |>
  add_baulos()

pp_applied_for <- applied_for |>
  mutate(
    bucket = case_when(
      missing_date         ~ "Kein Datum",
      weeks_open <  4       ~ "< 4 Wochen",
      weeks_open <  8       ~ "4–8 Wochen",
      weeks_open < 12       ~ "8–12 Wochen",
      TRUE                  ~ "> 12 Wochen"
    )
  ) |>
  count(`Planned by`, bucket, name = "n") |>
  rename(category = bucket)

pp_applied_for_detail <- applied_for |>
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      missing_date         ~ "Kein Datum",
      weeks_open <  4       ~ "< 4 Wochen",
      weeks_open <  8       ~ "4–8 Wochen",
      weeks_open < 12       ~ "8–12 Wochen",
      TRUE                  ~ "> 12 Wochen"
    )
  ) |>
  select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, Status, `Requested on`, weeks_open, category) |>
  add_baulos()

pp_open <- open_ip |>
  mutate(
    bucket = case_when(
      missing_date         ~ "Kein Datum",
      weeks_open <  4       ~ "< 4 Wochen",
      weeks_open <  8       ~ "4–8 Wochen",
      weeks_open < 12       ~ "8–12 Wochen",
      TRUE                  ~ "> 12 Wochen"
    )
  ) |>
  count(`Planned by`, bucket, name = "n") |>
  rename(category = bucket)

pp_open_detail <- open_ip |>
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      missing_date         ~ "Kein Datum",
      weeks_open <  4       ~ "< 4 Wochen",
      weeks_open <  8       ~ "4–8 Wochen",
      weeks_open < 12       ~ "8–12 Wochen",
      TRUE                  ~ "> 12 Wochen"
    )
  ) |>
  select(`External ID`, `Planned by`, Status, `Creation time`, weeks_open, category) |>
  add_baulos()

# Same filter logic as the Executive Summary's "Feeder gebaut ohne LR" KPI,
# broken down per project. One row per project — count only, no categories.
pp_feeder_built_no_lr <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") & built == "Yes") |>
  count(`Planned by`, name = "n")

pp_feeder_built_no_lr_detail <- infopoints |>
  filter(`FeederDrop Level` == "Feeder Level" & (is.na(Status) | Status != "receive") & built == "Yes") |>
  select(all_of(detail_cols)) |>
  mutate(category = "Feeder gebaut ohne LR") |>
  add_baulos()

# HP behind missing: NA, empty, or literal "0"
pp_hp_missing <- infopoints |>
  na_label("Status") |>
  filter(is.na(`HP behind`) | str_trim(`HP behind`) == "" | str_trim(`HP behind`) == "0") |>
  count(`Planned by`, Status, name = "n") |>
  rename(category = Status)

pp_hp_missing_detail <- infopoints |>
  na_label("Status") |>
  filter(is.na(`HP behind`) | str_trim(`HP behind`) == "" | str_trim(`HP behind`) == "0") |>
  select(all_of(detail_cols)) |>
  mutate(category = Status) |>
  add_baulos()

pp_projects <- infopoints |>
  distinct(`Planned by`) |>
  filter(!is.na(`Planned by`)) |>
  arrange(`Planned by`) |>
  pull(`Planned by`)

# Info box: one row per project with PCM, Bau_Planung, ende_bau_passiv_plan
pp_info <- infopoints |>
  distinct(`Planned by`, PCM, Bau_Planung, ende_bau_passiv_plan) |>
  filter(!is.na(`Planned by`))

# FttX Locations summary per project:
# Rows: fixed Scoping categories (In Scope, Outside Build Scope, Non Connectable, NA/leer)
# Columns per row: Scoping, n (count of addresses), sum_tu (sum of Planned TU)
# baulos_name included for Baulos filter in JS
pp_fttx <- fttx |>
  group_by(`Planned by`, Scoping, baulos_name) |>
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    sum_tu = sum(`Planned TU`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r project-pages-json}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
ch7_data <- list(
  exportDate          = infopoints_export_date,
  projects            = pp_projects,
  info                = pp_info,
  baulos_by_project   = pp_baulos_by_project,
  pcm_list            = pp_info |> distinct(PCM, `Planned by`) |> filter(!is.na(PCM)) |> arrange(PCM),
  status              = pp_status,
  status_detail       = pp_status_detail,
  feederdrop          = pp_feederdrop,
  feederdrop_detail   = pp_feederdrop_detail,
  built               = pp_built,
  built_detail        = pp_built_detail,
  applied_for         = pp_applied_for,
  applied_for_detail  = pp_applied_for_detail,
  open                = pp_open,
  open_detail         = pp_open_detail,
  feeder_no_lr        = pp_feeder_built_no_lr,
  feeder_no_lr_detail = pp_feeder_built_no_lr_detail,
  hp_missing          = pp_hp_missing,
  hp_missing_detail   = pp_hp_missing_detail,
  fttx                = pp_fttx,
  fttx_scoping_levels = SCOPING_LEVELS
)
json_str <- jsonlite::toJSON(ch7_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
cat(sprintf('<script id="ch7-data" type="application/json">\n%s\n</script>', json_str))
```
