```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const raw  = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("ch7-data").textContent);
  const DATA = {
    exportDate:         raw.exportDate || "",
    projects:           raw.projects   || [],
    info:               raw.info       || [],
    baulos_by_project:  raw.baulos_by_project || [],
    pcm_list:           raw.pcm_list   || [],
    status:             raw.status     || [],
    status_detail:      raw.status_detail || [],
    feederdrop:         raw.feederdrop || [],
    feederdrop_detail:  raw.feederdrop_detail || [],
    built:              raw.built      || [],
    built_detail:       raw.built_detail || [],
    applied_for:        raw.applied_for || [],
    applied_for_detail: raw.applied_for_detail || [],
    open:               raw.open       || [],
    open_detail:        raw.open_detail || [],
    feeder_no_lr:       raw.feeder_no_lr || [],
    feeder_no_lr_detail:raw.feeder_no_lr_detail || [],
    hp_missing:         raw.hp_missing || [],
    hp_missing_detail:  raw.hp_missing_detail || [],
    fttx:               raw.fttx || [],
    fttx_scoping_levels: raw.fttx_scoping_levels || ["In Scope","Outside Build Scope","Non Connectable","NA / leer"]
  };

  let selected  = [];
  let selBaulos = "";
  let selPCM    = "";
  let selFD     = [];  // selected FeederDrop levels ([] = show all)

  /* ── FeederDrop filter ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const FD_IDS = ["ch7fd0","ch7fd1","ch7fd2"];
  FD_IDS.forEach(id => {
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", () => {
      selFD = FD_IDS.map(i => document.getElementById(i)).filter(cb => cb.checked).map(cb => cb.value);
      document.getElementById("ch7fdclear").style.display = selFD.length ? "inline-block" : "none";
      renderCards();
    });
  });
  window.ch7ClearFD = () => {
    FD_IDS.forEach(id => { document.getElementById(id).checked = false; });
    selFD = [];
    document.getElementById("ch7fdclear").style.display = "none";
    renderCards();
  };

  /* ── PCM list ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildPCMList(filter) {
    filter = (filter || "").toLowerCase();
    const allPCMs = [...new Set(DATA.pcm_list.map(r => r.PCM))].sort();
    const shown   = filter ? allPCMs.filter(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(filter)) : allPCMs;
    document.getElementById("ch7pcmc").textContent = shown.length + " von " + allPCMs.length + " PCMs";
    const el = document.getElementById("ch7pcml");
    el.innerHTML = "";
    shown.forEach(pcm => {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.className = "ch7-proj-item" + (selPCM === pcm ? " sel" : "");
      d.textContent = pcm;
      d.onclick = () => {
        selPCM = selPCM === pcm ? "" : pcm;
        if (selPCM) {
          const pp = DATA.pcm_list.filter(r => r.PCM === selPCM).map(r => r["Planned by"]);
          selected = selected.filter(p => pp.includes(p));
          selBaulos = "";
        }
        document.getElementById("ch7pcmclear").style.display = selPCM ? "inline-block" : "none";
        buildPCMList(document.getElementById("ch7pcms").value);
        buildList(document.getElementById("ch7s").value);
        buildBaulosList(); renderTags(); renderCards();
      };
      el.appendChild(d);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById("ch7pcms").addEventListener("input", e => buildPCMList(e.target.value));
  window.ch7ClearPCM = () => {
    selPCM = "";
    document.getElementById("ch7pcms").value = "";
    document.getElementById("ch7pcmclear").style.display = "none";
    buildPCMList(); buildList(document.getElementById("ch7s").value);
  };

  /* ── Project list ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildList(filter) {
    filter = (filter || "").toLowerCase();
    const pp = selPCM ? new Set(DATA.pcm_list.filter(r => r.PCM === selPCM).map(r => r["Planned by"])) : null;
    const all = pp ? DATA.projects.filter(p => pp.has(p)) : DATA.projects;
    const shown = filter ? all.filter(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(filter)) : all;
    document.getElementById("ch7c").textContent = shown.length + " von " + all.length + " Projekten";
    const el = document.getElementById("ch7l"); el.innerHTML = "";
    shown.forEach(p => {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.className = "ch7-proj-item" + (selected.includes(p) ? " sel" : "");
      d.textContent = p;
      d.onclick = () => {
        selected = selected.includes(p) ? selected.filter(x => x !== p) : [...selected, p];
        selBaulos = "";
        buildList(document.getElementById("ch7s").value);
        buildBaulosList(); renderTags(); renderCards();
      };
      el.appendChild(d);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById("ch7s").addEventListener("input", e => buildList(e.target.value));

  /* ── Baulos dropdown ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildBaulosList() {
    const sel = document.getElementById("ch7bl");
    const btn = document.getElementById("ch7blc");
    const names = selected.length === 1
      ? DATA.baulos_by_project.filter(r => r["Planned by"] === selected[0]).map(r => r.baulos_name).sort()
      : [];
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— kein Baulos ausgewählt —</option>';
    if (!names.length) {
      sel.disabled = true;
      if (selected.length === 1) {
        const o = document.createElement("option"); o.disabled = true;
        o.textContent = "Keine Baulose für dieses Projekt"; sel.appendChild(o);
      }
    } else {
      sel.disabled = false;
      names.forEach(n => {
        const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = n; o.textContent = n;
        if (n === selBaulos) o.selected = true; sel.appendChild(o);
      });
    }
    btn.style.display = selBaulos ? "inline-block" : "none";
  }
  document.getElementById("ch7bl").addEventListener("change", e => {
    selBaulos = e.target.value;
    document.getElementById("ch7blc").style.display = selBaulos ? "inline-block" : "none";
    renderCards();
  });
  window.ch7ClearBaulos = () => {
    selBaulos = ""; document.getElementById("ch7bl").value = "";
    document.getElementById("ch7blc").style.display = "none"; renderCards();
  };

  /* ── Tags ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function renderTags() {
    const w = document.getElementById("ch7t"); w.innerHTML = "";
    selected.forEach(p => {
      const t = document.createElement("div"); t.className = "ch7-tag";
      t.innerHTML = p + ' <button title="Entfernen">\xd7</button>';
      t.querySelector("button").onclick = () => {
        selected = selected.filter(x => x !== p); selBaulos = "";
        buildList(document.getElementById("ch7s").value);
        buildBaulosList(); renderTags(); renderCards();
      };
      w.appendChild(t);
    });
  }

  /* ── CSV helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function dlCSV(rows, filename) {
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return;
    const cols = Object.keys(rows[0]);
    const esc = v => { const s = v == null ? "" : String(v); return /[";,\n]/.test(s) ? '"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"' : s; };
    const csv = [cols.join(";"), ...rows.map(r => cols.map(c => esc(r[c])).join(";"))].join("\r\n");
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(["\uFEFF"+csv],{type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8;"}));
    Object.assign(document.createElement("a"),{href:url,download:filename}).click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }
  function safe(s) { return String(s).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u00C0-\u017E_-]+/g,"_").slice(0,50); }
  function fileSuffix() {
    const safeP  = selected.length===1 ? safe(selected[0]) : selected.length+"Projekte";
    const safeBl = selBaulos ? "_"+safe(selBaulos) : "";
    const safeFD = selFD.length ? "_FD-"+selFD.map(safe).join("+") : "";
    return safeP + safeBl + safeFD + "_" + DATA.exportDate;
  }

  /* ── Aggregation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  // Apply FeederDrop filter to detail rows
  function applyFD(rows) {
    return selFD.length ? rows.filter(r => selFD.includes(r["FeederDrop Level"])) : rows;
  }

  // Returns [{cat, nTotal, nBaulos}]
  // nTotal = full project count (optionally FD-filtered), always the denominator
  // nBaulos = Baulos-filtered count (null when no Baulos selected)
  function sumCats(aggArr, detailArr, catField) {
    let mTot = new Map();
    if (selFD.length) {
      // Re-count from detail when FD filter active
      applyFD(detailArr.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"]))).forEach(r => {
        const k = r.category || "";
        mTot.set(k, (mTot.get(k) || 0) + 1);
      });
    } else {
      aggArr.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"])).forEach(r => {
        const k = r[catField] || r.category || "";
        mTot.set(k, (mTot.get(k) || 0) + (r.n || 0));
      });
    }

    let mBl = null;
    if (selBaulos) {
      mBl = new Map();
      applyFD(detailArr.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"]) && r.baulos_name === selBaulos))
        .forEach(r => { const k = r.category || ""; mBl.set(k, (mBl.get(k) || 0) + 1); });
    }

    return [...mTot.entries()].map(([cat, nTotal]) => ({
      cat, nTotal, nBaulos: mBl !== null ? (mBl.get(cat) || 0) : null
    })).sort((a,b) => b.nTotal - a.nTotal);
  }



  /* ── Table builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const ALL_FD = ["Drop Level","Feeder Level","NA / leer"];

  function buildTable(aggRows, detailArr, colLabel, prefix, order) {
    // For ordered tables, always show all expected rows with 0 if missing
    if (order) {
      const m = new Map(aggRows.map(r => [r.cat, r]));
      const hasBl = selBaulos ? true : false;
      aggRows = order.map(o => m.get(o) || {cat:o, nTotal:0, nBaulos: hasBl ? 0 : null});
    }
    // FeederDrop card: always show all three values including NA/leer
    if (colLabel === "Level") {
      const m = new Map(aggRows.map(r => [r.cat, r]));
      const hasBl = selBaulos ? true : false;
      aggRows = ALL_FD.map(s => m.get(s) || {cat:s, nTotal:0, nBaulos: hasBl ? 0 : null});
    }

    if (!aggRows.length) {
      const p = document.createElement("p"); p.className="ch7-empty"; p.textContent="Keine Daten."; return p;
    }

    const hasBaulos  = aggRows[0].nBaulos !== null;
    const totalTotal = aggRows.reduce((s,r) => s+r.nTotal, 0);
    const totalBl    = hasBaulos ? aggRows.reduce((s,r) => s+(r.nBaulos||0), 0) : null;
    const anzahlHead = hasBaulos ? "Baulos\u00a0/\u00a0Total" : "Anzahl";
    const totalFoot  = hasBaulos
      ? (totalBl + "\u00a0/\u00a0" + totalTotal.toLocaleString("de"))
      : totalTotal.toLocaleString("de");

    const sorted = order ? aggRows : [
      ...aggRows.filter(r => r.cat === "NA / leer"),
      ...aggRows.filter(r => r.cat !== "NA / leer")
    ];

    const tbl = document.createElement("table"); tbl.className="ch7-tbl";
    tbl.innerHTML =
      "<thead><tr><th>"+colLabel+"</th><th class='r'>"+anzahlHead+"</th><th class='r p'>%</th><th></th></tr></thead>" +
      "<tfoot><tr><td>Total</td><td class='r'>"+totalFoot+"</td><td class='r'>100%</td><td></td></tr></tfoot>";

    const tb = document.createElement("tbody");
    sorted.forEach(row => {
      const isNA   = row.cat === "NA / leer";
      const isZero = row.nTotal === 0 && (!hasBaulos || (row.nBaulos||0) === 0);
      const pct = totalTotal > 0
        ? (hasBaulos
            ? (row.nTotal > 0 ? (100*(row.nBaulos||0)/row.nTotal).toFixed(1)+"%" : "\u2014")
            : (100*row.nTotal/totalTotal).toFixed(1)+"%")
        : "\u2014";
      const nBl = row.nBaulos !== null ? (row.nBaulos || 0) : null;
      const anzahl = hasBaulos
        ? (nBl + "\u00a0/\u00a0" + row.nTotal.toLocaleString("de"))
        : row.nTotal.toLocaleString("de");

      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      // NA/leer: grey if 0, red if > 0
      if (isNA && isZero)     tr.className = "na-grey";
      else if (isNA)          tr.className = "na-red";

      tr.innerHTML = "<td>"+row.cat+"</td><td class='r'>"+anzahl+
        "</td><td class='p'>"+pct+"</td><td style='text-align:center;width:34px;'>"+
        "<button class='ch7-dl' title='Rohdaten herunterladen'>\u2b07</button></td>";
      tr.querySelector(".ch7-dl").onclick = () => {
        // Filter detail rows for this category + active filters
        const rows = applyFD(detailArr.filter(r =>
          selected.includes(r["Planned by"]) && r.category === cat &&
          (!selBaulos || r.baulos_name === selBaulos)
        )).map(r => { const o = Object.assign({},r); delete o.category; delete o.baulos_name; return o; });
        dlCSV(rows, prefix+"_"+safe(row.cat)+"_"+fileSuffix()+".csv");
      };
      tb.appendChild(tr);
    });
    tbl.insertBefore(tb, tbl.querySelector("tfoot"));
    return tbl;
  }

  /* ── Card definitions ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const WAIT = ["< 4 Wochen","4\u20138 Wochen","8\u201312 Wochen","> 12 Wochen","Kein Datum"];
  const ALL_STATUSES = ["open","applied for","receive","rejected","no response","NA / leer"];

  const CARDS = [
    { title:"Status", col:"Status", prefix:"status",
      agg:() => {
        const found = sumCats(DATA.status, DATA.status_detail, "category");
        const m = new Map(found.map(r=>[r.cat,r]));
        const hasBl = selBaulos;
        return ALL_STATUSES.map(s => m.get(s) || {cat:s, nTotal:0, nBaulos: hasBl ? 0 : null});
      }, detail:DATA.status_detail, order:null },
    { title:"FeederDrop Level", col:"Level", prefix:"feederdrop",
      agg:()=>sumCats(DATA.feederdrop, DATA.feederdrop_detail, "category"),
      detail:DATA.feederdrop_detail, order:null },
    { title:"Built (gebaut ja/nein)", col:"Built", prefix:"built",
      agg:()=>sumCats(DATA.built, DATA.built_detail, "category"),
      detail:DATA.built_detail, order:null },
    { title:"Feeder gebaut ohne LR", col:"Kennzahl", prefix:"feeder_gebaut_ohne_lr",
      agg:()=>{
        let nTotal, nBaulos;
        if (selFD.length) {
          const fd = applyFD(DATA.feeder_no_lr_detail.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"])));
          nTotal = fd.length;
          nBaulos = selBaulos ? applyFD(DATA.feeder_no_lr_detail.filter(r =>
            selected.includes(r["Planned by"]) && r.baulos_name === selBaulos)).length : null;
        } else {
          nTotal = DATA.feeder_no_lr.filter(r=>selected.includes(r["Planned by"])).reduce((s,r)=>s+(r.n||0),0);
          nBaulos = selBaulos
            ? DATA.feeder_no_lr_detail.filter(r=>selected.includes(r["Planned by"]) && r.baulos_name===selBaulos).length
            : null;
        }
        return [{cat:"Feeder gebaut ohne LR", nTotal, nBaulos}];
      }, detail:DATA.feeder_no_lr_detail, order:null },
    { title:"Applied for \u2014 Wartezeit", col:"Wartezeit", prefix:"applied_for",
      agg:()=>sumCats(DATA.applied_for, DATA.applied_for_detail, "category"),
      detail:DATA.applied_for_detail, order:WAIT },
    { title:"Open \u2014 Wartezeit", col:"Wartezeit", prefix:"open",
      agg:()=>sumCats(DATA.open, DATA.open_detail, "category"),
      detail:DATA.open_detail, order:WAIT },
    { title:"HP behind fehlt", col:"Status", prefix:"hp_missing",
      agg:() => {
        const found = sumCats(DATA.hp_missing, DATA.hp_missing_detail, "category");
        const m = new Map(found.map(r=>[r.cat,r]));
        const hasBl = selBaulos ? true : false;
        return ALL_STATUSES.map(s => m.get(s) || {cat:s, nTotal:0, nBaulos: hasBl ? 0 : null});
      }, detail:DATA.hp_missing_detail, order:null },
    { title:"FttX Locations Scoping", col:null, prefix:"fttx",
      isFttx: true,
      agg:() => {
        const levels = DATA.fttx_scoping_levels;
        const mN  = new Map();
        const mTU = new Map();
        let rows = DATA.fttx.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"]));
        if (selBaulos) rows = rows.filter(r => r.baulos_name === selBaulos);
        rows.forEach(r => {
          const k = r.Scoping || "NA / leer";
          mN.set(k,  (mN.get(k)  || 0) + (r.n      || 0));
          mTU.set(k, (mTU.get(k) || 0) + (r.sum_tu || 0));
        });
        return levels.map(s => ({
          cat: s, n: mN.get(s) || 0, sum_tu: mTU.get(s) || 0
        }));
      }, detail:null, order:null }
  ];

  /* ── FttX table builder (Scoping | Anzahl | Sum TU, no %) ───────────── */
  function buildFttxTable(aggRows) {
    const totalN  = aggRows.reduce((s,r) => s + r.n,      0);
    const totalTU = aggRows.reduce((s,r) => s + r.sum_tu, 0);

    const sorted = [
      ...aggRows.filter(r => r.cat === "NA / leer"),
      ...aggRows.filter(r => r.cat !== "NA / leer")
    ];

    const tbl = document.createElement("table"); tbl.className="ch7-tbl";
    tbl.innerHTML =
      "<thead><tr><th>Scoping</th><th class='r'>Adressen</th><th class='r'>Sum TU</th></tr></thead>" +
      "<tfoot><tr><td>Total</td><td class='r'>"+totalN.toLocaleString("de")+
      "</td><td class='r'>"+Math.round(totalTU).toLocaleString("de")+"</td></tr></tfoot>";

    const tb = document.createElement("tbody");
    sorted.forEach(row => {
      const isNA   = row.cat === "NA / leer";
      const isZero = row.n === 0 && row.sum_tu === 0;
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (isNA && isZero) tr.className = "na-grey";
      else if (isNA)      tr.className = "na-red";
      tr.innerHTML = "<td>"+row.cat+"</td>" +
        "<td class='r'>"+row.n.toLocaleString("de")+"</td>" +
        "<td class='r'>"+Math.round(row.sum_tu).toLocaleString("de")+"</td>";
      tb.appendChild(tr);
    });
    tbl.insertBefore(tb, tbl.querySelector("tfoot"));
    return tbl;
  }

  /* ── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function renderCards() {
    const grid = document.getElementById("ch7g");
    const wait = document.getElementById("ch7w");
    const bnr  = document.getElementById("ch7b");
    const iw   = document.getElementById("ch7-info-wrap");

    if (!selected.length) {
      grid.style.display="none"; wait.style.display="block";
      bnr.style.display="none"; iw.style.display="none"; return;
    }
    wait.style.display="none"; grid.style.display="grid";

    // Banner
    const parts = [];
    if (selBaulos) parts.push("Baulos: \u201e"+selBaulos+"\u201c");
    if (selFD.length) parts.push("FeederDrop: "+selFD.join(", "));
    bnr.style.display = parts.length ? "block" : "none";
    if (parts.length) bnr.textContent = "\u2139\ufe0f  Filter aktiv \u2014 "+parts.join(" | ")+(selBaulos?" \u2014 Anzahl zeigt Baulos\u00a0/\u00a0Gesamt":"");

    // Info box
    iw.style.display = "block"; iw.innerHTML = "";
    const infoCard = document.createElement("div"); infoCard.className="ch7-card ch7-info-card";
    const infoHdr = document.createElement("div"); infoHdr.className="ch7-card-hdr";

    // Collect all detail rows for the selected project(s) for download
    // "Alle" = full project, no filters; "Gefiltert" = respects Baulos + FD
    const allProjectRows = () => {
      // Union all detail arrays, deduplicate by External ID, strip internal cols
      const seen = new Set();
      const out  = [];
      for (const arr of [DATA.status_detail, DATA.applied_for_detail, DATA.open_detail,
                         DATA.feeder_no_lr_detail, DATA.hp_missing_detail]) {
        arr.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"])).forEach(r => {
          if (!seen.has(r["External ID"])) {
            seen.add(r["External ID"]);
            const o = Object.assign({}, r);
            delete o.category; delete o.baulos_name;
            out.push(o);
          }
        });
      }
      return out;
    };
    const filteredProjectRows = () => {
      const seen = new Set();
      const out  = [];
      for (const arr of [DATA.status_detail, DATA.applied_for_detail, DATA.open_detail,
                         DATA.feeder_no_lr_detail, DATA.hp_missing_detail]) {
        applyFD(arr.filter(r =>
          selected.includes(r["Planned by"]) && (!selBaulos || r.baulos_name === selBaulos)
        )).forEach(r => {
          if (!seen.has(r["External ID"])) {
            seen.add(r["External ID"]);
            const o = Object.assign({}, r);
            delete o.category; delete o.baulos_name;
            out.push(o);
          }
        });
      }
      return out;
    };

    const btnWrap = document.createElement("div");
    btnWrap.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;";
    const btnAll = document.createElement("button"); btnAll.className="ch7-card-dl";
    btnAll.textContent = "\u2b07 Alle";
    btnAll.title = "Alle Infopoints dieses Projekts (ohne Filter)";
    btnAll.onclick = () => dlCSV(allProjectRows(), "infopoints_alle_"+fileSuffix().replace(/^[^_]+/,safe(selected[0]||"projekt"))+"_"+DATA.exportDate+".csv");
    const btnFil = document.createElement("button"); btnFil.className="ch7-card-dl";
    btnFil.textContent = "\u2b07 Gefiltert";
    btnFil.title = "Infopoints mit aktiven Filtern (Baulos / FeederDrop)";
    btnFil.onclick = () => dlCSV(filteredProjectRows(), "infopoints_gefiltert_"+fileSuffix()+".csv");

    infoHdr.innerHTML = "<span>Info</span>";
    btnWrap.appendChild(btnAll); btnWrap.appendChild(btnFil);
    infoHdr.appendChild(btnWrap);
    infoCard.appendChild(infoHdr);

    const pir = DATA.info.filter(r => selected.includes(r["Planned by"]));
    if (selected.length === 1 && pir.length > 0) {
      const r = pir[0];
      const tbl = document.createElement("table"); tbl.className="ch7-info-tbl";
      [["PCM", r.PCM||"\u2014"],
       ["Status (Bau/Planung)", r.Bau_Planung||"\u2014"],
       ["Ende Bau passiv/Plan", r.ende_bau_passiv_plan||"\u2014"]
      ].forEach(([lbl,val]) => {
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");
        tr.innerHTML = "<td>"+lbl+"</td><td>"+val+"</td>";
        tbl.appendChild(tr);
      });
      infoCard.appendChild(tbl);
    } else {
      const note = document.createElement("div"); note.className="ch7-info-multi";
      note.textContent = selected.length+" Projekte ausgewählt — Info wird nur für Einzelprojekte angezeigt.";
      infoCard.appendChild(note);
    }
    iw.appendChild(infoCard);

    // Metric cards
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    CARDS.forEach(def => {
    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = def.isFttx ? "ch7-card fttx-card" : "ch7-card";
    const hdr  = document.createElement("div");
      hdr.className = def.isFttx ? "ch7-card-hdr fttx" : "ch7-card-hdr";
      const titleSpan = document.createElement("span"); titleSpan.textContent = def.title;
      hdr.appendChild(titleSpan);

      // Download button — skip for FttX card (no detail rows)
      if (!def.isFttx) {
        const dlBtn = document.createElement("button"); dlBtn.className="ch7-card-dl";
        dlBtn.textContent = "\u2b07 Download";
        dlBtn.onclick = () => {
          const rows = applyFD(def.detail.filter(r =>
            selected.includes(r["Planned by"]) && (!selBaulos || r.baulos_name === selBaulos)
          )).map(r => { const o = Object.assign({},r); delete o.category; delete o.baulos_name; return o; });
          dlCSV(rows, def.prefix+"_alle_"+fileSuffix()+".csv");
        };
        hdr.appendChild(dlBtn);
      }

      card.appendChild(hdr);
      card.appendChild(def.isFttx
        ? buildFttxTable(def.agg())
        : buildTable(def.agg(), def.detail, def.col, def.prefix, def.order));
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  /* ── Boot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  buildPCMList();
  buildList();
  buildBaulosList();
})();
</script>
```

::: {.callout-note}
Alle fünf Ansichten beziehen sich auf **`r n_total` aktive, nicht stornierte
Infopoints** (dieselbe Basis wie im restlichen Bericht). Bei Auswahl mehrerer
Projekte werden die Zahlen über alle ausgewählten Projekte aufsummiert.
"Applied for" und "Open" zeigen die Wartezeit-Verteilung nur für Infopoints
mit dem jeweiligen Status.
:::

---

## Informationen/Quellen

### Metadaten

```{r metadata-table}
tibble(
  Feld  = c("Version", "Erstellt am", "Infopoints-Datei", "Projektliste-Datei", "Datenquelle"),
  Wert  = c(version_number, as.character(today), infopoints_file, excel_file, base_path)
) |>
  reactable(
    sortable  = FALSE,
    bordered  = TRUE,
    striped   = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    theme = reactableTheme(
      headerStyle  = list(background = "#2c3e50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold"),
      stripedColor = "#f8f9fa"
    )
  )
```

### Aktive Projekte gemäß Pias/PCM Liste (siehe Projektliste-Datei)

Projekte, die im Bericht berücksichtigt werden (ohne "on hold").

```{r active-projects-table}
project_list_full |>
  filter(`Bau/Planung` != "on hold") |>
  reactable(
    filterable      = TRUE,
    sortable        = TRUE,
    striped         = TRUE,
    highlight       = TRUE,
    bordered        = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    theme = reactableTheme(
      headerStyle  = list(background = "#2c3e50", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold"),
      stripedColor = "#f8f9fa"
    )
  )
```

### Projekte "On Hold"

```{r on-hold-projects-table}
project_list_full |>
  filter(`Bau/Planung` == "on hold") |>
  reactable(
    filterable      = TRUE,
    sortable        = TRUE,
    striped         = TRUE,
    highlight       = TRUE,
    bordered        = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    theme = reactableTheme(
      headerStyle  = list(background = "#95a5a6", color = "white", fontWeight = "bold"),
      stripedColor = "#f8f9fa"
    )
  )
```
